_about: Every number the simulator, the constraint layer and the arbiter use. All money is integer INR. These are modelling assumptions for an illustrative auto-components MSME (about Rs 6 crore turnover a year), not measured data; the README lists them as assumptions.

constraints._about: covenant_min_current_ratio 1.33 is the Tandon-committee norm banks apply to working-capital limits in India. stress_largest_receivable_delay_weeks: when above 0, every look-ahead assumes the largest unpaid customer invoice is paid that many weeks later than forecast (a generic pessimism margin, off by default; used as an ablation).

objective._about: J(S) = w_profit * sum(confidence_i * profit_i) + w_risk * sum(risk_reduction_i) + w_liquidity * min(min_headroom(S), liquidity_target), where min_headroom is the lowest projected cash above the buffer over the horizon. The Arbiter maximises J over feasible subsets of the proposals.

baselines._about: Priority of each department in the voting baseline (b); it has no constraint awareness.
